Colleagues in London get theirs on Monday as expected. Our account settings
have the right time zone for each of us.

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The code in src/notifications/rollup.ts sends the weekly rollup email at 8 AM local time on the first day of the user's week, which is supposed to be Monday based on the user's time zone. However, the reported issue suggests that users in Sydney receive the Monday summary email on Tuesday morning, indicating a potential mismatch in how the start of the week or local time is being calculated for some time zones. This file is the main place where the sending time logic is implemented and should be examined closely to verify the time zone handling and start-of-week calculation.
